registry_scope: Source metadata and future reference proposals only; no acquisition or validation evidence

sources.title: Gene expression across mammalian organ development: mouse
sources.reference_scope: Observed developmental expression and published collection-stage metadata; no latent temporal program, causal network or universal pseudotime truth
metadata_requirements: Sample-to-expression-column mapping and source metadata hash
Organ, organism, sex where available, and original chronological stage label
Documented conversion of developmental labels to a chronological numeric scale
Animal or donor identifiers and evidence distinguishing biological from technical replicates
Batch and library preparation provenance, including missingness
Predeclared bounded gene and sample selection, with no outcome-based marker filtering

historical_cache_note.scope: Prior cache description only; this registry did not read, hash or validate that cache

sources.title: SEQC reference RNA, mixtures and ERCC controls
sources.reference_scope: Processed count tables with known A/B mixtures and ERCC titration controls; control-specific ratios and ordering, not all-gene biological or causal truth
metadata_requirements: Exact processed count table, quantification pipeline, feature identifiers and source hash
A/B reference source, C=3A+1B and D=1A+3B mixture definitions and preparation provenance
ERCC identifiers, input mixes and expected ratios from source metadata
Laboratory site, sequencing platform, library preparation and technical replicate identifiers
Pooled RNA and aliquot identities; library replicates must not become independent donors
Control-specific contrast and enrichment/normalization assumptions before scoring

sources.title: Spearheading future omics analyses using dyngen, a multi-modal simulator of single cells
sources.reference_scope: Potential future mechanistic simulation with explicit generator lineage/network truth; not implemented or acquired here
metadata_requirements: Pinned simulator version and license, configured network and kinetic assumptions
Explicit generation authorization and independent generation seeds
Cell lineage, simulation time, sampling and biological-unit conventions
Generator-private truth and separate model-misspecification assessment

sources.title: scDesign3 generates realistic in silico data for multimodal single-cell and spatial omics
sources.reference_scope: Potential future reference-fitted simulation with known configured distributions; reference fit does not establish biological causal truth
metadata_requirements: Pinned simulator version, license and explicitly authorized public fitting reference
Reference source hash, selection rules and donor/cell nesting
Fitted distribution, covariates, dependence model and negative/positive control definitions
Separate fitting and evaluation cohorts to prevent reference leakage

sources.title: Mapping information-rich genotype-phenotype landscapes with genome-scale Perturb-seq
sources.reference_scope: Intervention-associated transcriptional responses under assayed contexts; no complete direct-regulatory-edge, promoter-binding or universal causal truth
metadata_requirements: Selected processed matrix and source hash, with bounded cell and gene selection
Guide identity, perturbation target, assignment confidence and control guides
Cell line, batch, experimental replicate and biological-unit nesting
Perturbation efficiency, collection timing and context-specific contrast definitions
Explicit off-target, indirect-effect and replicate-dependence limitations
